{"consolidated_memory":"STALE STATE ISSUES IN ui/state/cacheSlice.ts - TWO OCCASIONS

Component: ui/state/cacheSlice.ts (web UI side)
Common signal across both occasions: old values still in the store snapshot
Common repro: edit a record then navigate back to the list
Context: Both issues were in the same corner of cacheSlice.ts, where earlier stale state work had been done (context carried over between occasions)

---

OCCASION 1: [2026-06-08]
Affected: Clients pinned to v1 SDK
Root cause: A cache entry was never invalidated on write
Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
PR: #3744 on branch fix/stale-state-5
Measured outcome: Cold start performance dropped 61 percent, to 156 ms

---

OCCASION 2: [2026-06-22]
Affected: Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
Root cause: The serializer was dropping fields it did not know
Fix: Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
PR: #5996 on branch fix/stale-state-6
Measured outcome: Job finished in 67 minutes instead of 6 hours"}
